title: Steamed Salmon & Vegetable Rice Bowl
description: Flaked salmon over jasmine rice with steamed broccoli, snap peas and a ginger-soy glaze.
steps: Steam the salmon until it flakes easily, then flake into large pieces.
Steam the broccoli and snap peas until tender-crisp.
Divide the rice into bowls, top with vegetables and salmon, then drizzle with the ginger-soy glaze.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste steamed salmon rice bowl

notes: Steaming preserves the salmon's omega-3s better than high-heat cooking methods.
